name: Cat head frame-fixed no-weld aluminum mount V0.2 rear-backplate handoff
status: integration geometry review candidate; portal coupon, rail shoes, rear-base pass-throughs, paper and cardboard checks required before metal

bike_interface.mount_mode: fixed to the four factory front head-tube accessory bosses
bike_interface.thread_nominal: M6; verify with the removed factory bolt before ordering hardware
bike_interface.frame_clearance_observation: User physically confirmed that handlebar steering does not enter the four-boss connector area. The existing fork-mounted headlight occupies the volume below the connector; V0.2 raises the head rear interface 75 mm, but actual housing and beam clearance are still unvalidated.
bike_interface.headlight_decision: Retain the existing fork-mounted headlight. Validate housing clearance and beam through the complete steering sweep with the actual Gate8 GLB or an accurate full-size cardboard head volume.

pose.boss_plane_angle_source: Perspective-corrected estimate from the user side photo; validate with the 1:1 side template before metal release.

headlight_reference.measurement_quality: rough physical measurement supplied by user
headlight_reference.status: vertical datum only; the actual 330 mm Gate 8 shell overlaps this elevation in projection, so housing and beam clearance require the full 3D bike mockup
headlight_reference.rejected_v01_clearance_claim: The earlier 30.02 mm reference-envelope claim used a simplified 260 mm-high box and is invalid for the actual 330 mm shell.

side_webs.formed_geometry: Diagonal central web connects a vertical rear bend line to the compact bike-adapter bend line at 60 mm forward and 75 mm upward.
side_webs.fasteners: Two M5 through-bolts, washers, and nyloc nuts at each rear flange and each front flange

head_interface.architecture: The bike connector ends at a removable aluminum rear backplate. Two separate internal rails run from machined lower rail shoes on that plate to revised blind Gate 8 upper-shell sockets.

aluminum_backplate.perimeter_and_rail_shoe_holes_status: Deferred until the rear-base pass-through coupon and mirrored machined rail shoes are physically reviewed; this plate is review geometry, not cut-ready.

internal_rails.socket_roll_reference: head X projected perpendicular to each rail axis
internal_rails.top_retention: One transverse M4 bolt per blind printed socket, 10 mm inside the mouth.
internal_rails.lower_retention: Two mirrored machined 6061 solid-plug flange shoes, cross-bolted into the square tubes and through-bolted to the backplate; exact shoe geometry is the next release gate.

portal_revision.selected_result: Re-aimed rails terminate on the rear-backplate plane 15 mm above its lower edge; socket M4 axes are nearly horizontal and remain at least 8.205 mm behind the exterior shell plane.

rejected_v01_external_tubes.root_adjustment: Cut tubes oversize and leave their rear ends projecting through the 29 mm yoke openings during fit-up. Seat both upper ends against the blind Gate 8 socket stops, set head position, then mark and drill the lower clevis holes.

rejected_v01_external_tube_clevis.fasteners: Eight M5 yoke mounting bolts plus four M5 transverse tube bolts, all with washers and nyloc nuts
rejected_v01_external_tube_clevis.anti_crush_sleeves: Four fitted metal sleeves, one per transverse bolt. Final outside diameter and length require actual tube wall and inside-width measurement; sleeve ends must carry bolt clamp load without collapsing the hollow tube.

hardware_release_notes: The 60 mm headlight datum is a rough physical measurement. Do not release metal until the actual 330 mm Gate 8 shell and the bike headlight are checked together in a full-size 3D/cardboard mockup through the steering sweep.
Do not order frame bolts from the nominal model alone. Verify the factory M6 thread and blind-hole depth, then choose a length that reproduces the factory engagement without bottoming.
Use isolation washers or anti-seize appropriate to stainless-on-aluminum hardware and follow the verified fastener supplier torque guidance.
The side-web flat pattern depends on the selected fabricator's bend radius, K-factor, and tooling. The generated formed drawing is authoritative; the vendor must calculate its flat pattern.
Add an independent metal safety tether from the rear plate slot to the bike frame.

This V0.2 is not approved for metal or riding until the portal coupon, lower rail-shoe design, rear-base pass-throughs, paper template, cardboard volume mockup, full fit-up, proof load, vibration test, and progressive ride tests pass.
